overview.en: Sympistis funebris is a noctuid moth of boreal and alpine regions.
overview.fr: Sympistis funebris est un papillon noctuide des régions boréales et alpines.

identification.en: It is a small, dark moth; its forewing is about 11–12 mm long.
identification.fr: C’est un petit papillon sombre, dont l’aile antérieure mesure environ 11–12 mm.

habitat.en: It occurs in high-elevation alpine meadows and heathlands of western North America, and has a broader Holarctic range.
habitat.fr: Il fréquente les pelouses alpines et landes d’altitude de l’ouest de l’Amérique du Nord, et possède une aire holarctique plus vaste.

diet.en: The caterpillars feed on shrubs and trees including bilberries (Vaccinium), birches (Betula) and crowberries (Empetrum).
diet.fr: Les chenilles se nourrissent notamment d’arbustes et d’arbres tels que les airelles (Vaccinium), les bouleaux (Betula) et les camarines (Empetrum).

behavior.en: Adults fly by day and visit flowers; in the Pacific Northwest they are recorded mainly in July and August.
behavior.fr: Les adultes volent de jour et butinent les fleurs ; dans le Nord-Ouest pacifique, ils sont surtout observés en juillet et août.

reproduction.en: The regional account documents larval host plants but gives no further detail on egg-laying or development.
reproduction.fr: La fiche régionale indique des plantes hôtes des chenilles, sans détailler la ponte ni le développement.

ecology.en: Its larval hosts and flower-visiting adults connect it to alpine heath and meadow vegetation.
ecology.fr: Ses plantes hôtes larvaires et ses adultes floricoles l’associent à la végétation des landes et pelouses alpines.

conservation.en: The French observatory reports Least Concern in Europe; this regional status is not a global assessment.
conservation.fr: L’observatoire français indique la catégorie Préoccupation mineure en Europe ; ce statut régional n’est pas une évaluation mondiale.

facts: Western Washington University describes a small dark moth of alpine meadows and heaths, with an 11–12 mm forewing, and its boreal North American range.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

facts: The French observatory lists Vaccinium, Betula and Empetrum as larval hosts; adults forage by day, and the European category is Least Concern.

uncertainties: The PNW Moths account states that larval foodplants were not known to its authors; the French observatory supplies host records. A Europe-wide status is not equivalent to a global assessment.
